label: wo oite
title_raw: 〜をおいて (を措いて) ([〜をおいて] )(wo oite)
title: 〜をおいて (を措いて)
meaning: apart from/leaving aside 〜を除いて。〜をさしおいて。

examples.japanese: あなたをおいて、この会社の社長の適任者はいない
examples.body_text:
あなたをおいて、この会社の社長の適任者はいない 

		Apart from you, there is noone suitable for this company's President.
examples.body_html:
あなたをおいて、この会社の社長の適任者はいない  
Apart from you, there is noone suitable for this company's President.

examples.japanese: 日本のミサから:「主よ、あなたは神の子キリスト、永遠の命の糧。あなたをおいて誰のところに行きましょう。」
examples.body_text:
日本のミサから:「主よ、あなたは神の子キリスト、永遠の命の糧。あなたをおいて誰のところに行きましょう。」 

		From the Japanese Mass: "Lord, you are Christ, the Son of God, Bread of eternal life. Without you, to whom should we go?"

examples.japanese: The personal computer is used at not only the office but also home recently.

		最近は職場だけでなく家庭においてもパャRンが使われている.

comments.text: ozonitabetai, I don't know if I can say that your sentence is grammatically incorrect, but I can say that I have a real tough time figuring out what it is supposed to be saying^^:  "Except for what happened yesterday, how are (you, we...) going home today?" is how it reads to me.  So, I'd have to say that for my two yen, it's probably not an ideal application of the grammar point.
